html:
Session 07 — Ironhold and the Forge Council

[!important] 🎙 START RECORDING before the session opens. Check the mic level, confirm the file is writing, and only then read the opener aloud. If you forget until later, note the timestamp when recording began so the recap workflow can pad the earlier beats from memory.

Outline only. Full prep after Session 6 plays.

Beat structure (provisional)

  1. Arrival in town. First impressions. The smelting fires. The Forge Council building. The Aurum Dominion delegation already established at the best inn.
  2. Sera’s sister: track down Halvor. Confront him at his warehouse. The full moral grey reveal — see structure below.
  3. The Forge Council crisis. Bryndis Ashveil vs Corvan Drake. Veris Caelthorn’s audience. The party can witness, intervene, take a side.
  4. Brother Daven Soltan at the small Temple of Luminos — knew Merric. Orin’s emotional beat. Optional.
  5. Marius Vell — “wine merchant,” charming, asks too many questions. Player gets to enjoy clocking him (or not).
  6. Investigate the chest delivery. The black carriage rode north. Investigation in the warehouse district. Trail goes cold but they learn the carriage type, the destination (“a cache somewhere north”).
  7. Departure preparation. Brenna pays the party. Hooks for return to Aeloria established.

The Halvor moral grey — full structure

Discovery sequence

  1. Sera leads the party to Halvor’s warehouse on the edge of town.
  2. Confront Halvor. He’ll lie at first (“they owe me money”), then break under pressure.
  3. The full picture surfaces: Halvor borrowed from Davos Hark in Aeloria 18 months ago. His own creditors are crushing him. His daughter Lis is held in Aeloria by Davos’s thugs as collateral — 12 days left or she’s sold. He took Mira and the children hoping the Marcus family would pay something.
  4. The thug guarding the warehouse — Cor Brackin — is sleeping, drinking, unhappy with the work. Not loyal to Halvor; loyal to the gold.

Options

  • Pay the Marcus debt themselves (30 gp). Family freed. Halvor flees Ironhold in shame. Lis still in danger in Aeloria.
  • Force release. Family freed. Halvor publicly ruined within a week. Lis lost (off-screen). Greymarsh — Stillbrook — divided about the resolution.
  • Negotiate the full solution. Halvor releases the family in exchange for the party’s promise to help with Davos Hark in Aeloria. Best outcome — becomes a return-hook arc.
  • Do nothing. Family eventually broken. Reputation consequence in Stillbrook.

What the party learns about Davos Hark (only if they ask Halvor specifically)

  • Counting-house in Aeloria’s Merchants Rise district.
  • Two thugs guard Lis in a back-room apartment.
  • Davos himself is not the worst of them. He’s also being squeezed. The chain points upward to Aurum-Dominion-pressured merchants in Aeloria.
  • A future thread: pulling Davos’s records eventually surfaces one piece of Aurek correspondence. (Not flagged this session.)

Reward / consequence

  • Brenna respects the resolution path (or doesn’t). Trust adjustment.
  • Sera, Mira, the children — fate set.
  • Halvor’s outcome set.
  • Lis is a return-hook.

The Forge Council crisis

Bryndis Ashveil vs Corvan Drake is reaching a head. Council vote within the week. Drake has more votes right now. Veris Caelthorn’s presence is forcing the timeline.

The party can: - Stay out of it. Honour the contract, take the pay, leave. (Drake wins by default.) - Support Bryndis. Investigate Drake’s compromises — bribery, gambling debts, a kept lover in town. Use what they find at the Council meeting. - Support Drake. He’ll pay them well for it. Major reputational cost in Aeloria. - Try to broker a third option — split contracts, partial concessions. Hard, depends on diplomatic ability.

Rewards

  • Bryndis: a quality forge-piece at cost (one masterwork-tier weapon).
  • Drake: gold and a long-term friendly merchant connection. Plus quietly: a “wine merchant’s” contact for sensitive deliveries north (this is Marius Vell).
  • Neutral: just the contract pay, no friction.

The black carriage

Investigation at the warehouse district where the chest was delivered:

  • Warehouse #14 is empty. Recently swept. No staff on site.
  • Stable hand at the next door over saw a small black carriage with one driver, departing within an hour of delivery, riding north.
  • The driver was hooded; the carriage had no markings.
  • Tracking: rolled north on the main road. Lost the trail at the first major crossroads.

The party may piece together that this connects to the chest’s seal (the Coin Cipher mark Torren spotted). They may NOT yet connect it to Aurek/Vaeloran.

End of session

Brenna pays the party. She offers them passage back north with the caravan (it’ll be three days return) or they can ride faster if they have horses. Cliffhanger options:

  • Sera’s emotional goodbye.
  • A note from Davos Hark in Aeloria (passed via courier) — “I hear you have my asset’s daughter’s whereabouts in mind. I look forward to discussing matters when you return.” — if the party committed to helping with Lis.
  • A faint plume of smoke from Aeloria’s direction, far north — distant trouble.
